name: app-oviah-pain-points-six-numbered-cards
title: OVIAH pain points: six numbered lilac cards answering 'What makes menstrual health management difficult?'
whatItIs: A 3x2 grid of alternating light and mid-lilac cards, each with a large numeral (01–06) and a short pain point: Physical discomfort, Understanding symptoms, Information overload, Tracking fatigue, Notifications, Privacy, each with a one-line elaboration.
whatItMeans: Clear and prioritised; numbering pain points implies an order of importance the design should address first.
techniques: Number findings to imply a priority order.
Pair a short title with a single-line elaboration per card.
Alternate card tints across a numbered grid for rhythm.

vocabulary.definition: A specific problem or frustration a user experiences.
A card led by a large index number for ordering.
